exposure: Suicidal behavior at the time of delivery
cohort: US women with delivery hospitalizations from 2007-2012 National (Nationwide) Inpatient Sample.
finding: Women with suicidal behavior at the time of delivery were at increased risk for various adverse obstetric outcomes, including antepartum hemorrhage, placental abruption, postpartum hemorrhage, premature delivery, stillbirth, poor fetal growth, and fetal anomalies.
mod_finding: No significant association was observed for maternal suicidal behavior with cesarean delivery.
